title: Tala Durith
description: Tala Durith was an officer in the Galactic Empire, but also a Rebel spy. Her group helped Jedi and others escape from the Inquisitors. Durith helped Kenobi rescue Princess Leia Organa from Fortress Inquisitorius. When Darth Vader attacked the secret base on Jabiim, a wounded Durith sacrificed herself with a thermal detonator.
